scope: Aggregate structure of the Out 2 block (effect ID 43) in one user-owned commercial FW13 tonepack, as serialised by the FM3. Counts only: no preset files, names or parameter values. Produced by tools/fm3/out2-corpus-evidence.mjs.
findings: In every preset with Out 2 (332/332) its record is the preset's own Out 1 record with effect ID 43: I/O header (zero), 26 words x 4 channels, and it follows Out 1 in record order.
The Out 2 record also equals the jb-newlook base's Out 1 record after the effect ID (332/332), so the base supplies the template; no tonepack content is copied.
315/332 place Out 2 at row 4, column 12 under Out 1 (row 3, column 12); 327/332 feed it from the same row as Out 1 (mask 4 = row 3, mask 2 = row 2).
312 presets also keep two shunts in row 4 (columns 10-11) fed from row 2 that reach no output (a pre-Cab branch template); the generator does not write them.
notProven: Out 2 signal on the physical jacks
